title: tron.event.v1
description: Canonical event envelope for TRON operational/audit events shipped to Trading Graylog (PID section 15). Contract-owner: WI-B (WO-TRON-D1). This envelope does not enumerate or close the event-type catalogue; the illustrative event names in PID section 15 are 'at minimum', and the authoritative catalogue is owned by WI-G (09-EVENTS-AND-GRAYLOG.md).

contract_version.description: Canonical contract major version. Must equal "1" for tron.event.v1.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this individual event instance.

event_type.description: Dot-namespaced event type name (e.g. "action.received", "execution.filled"). Deliberately not a closed enum in this envelope contract: PID section 15 lists event types 'at minimum', and the full catalogue is owned by WI-G. This contract only constrains the naming shape, not the permitted set of values.

occurred_at_ms.description: UTC epoch-ms at which the underlying event occurred.

action_id.description: Correlated falcon.trade_action.v1 action_id, where an action identity exists for this event. Absent means no action identity is applicable to this event.

intent_id.description: Correlated tron.trade_intent.v1 intent_id, where an intent identity exists for this event. Absent means no intent identity is applicable to this event.

order_id.description: Correlated broker order identity (tron.execution_report.v1 broker_order_id), where an order identity exists for this event. Absent means no order identity is applicable to this event.

execution_id.description: Correlated individual broker execution/fill identity (tron.execution_report.v1 fills[].execution_id), where an execution identity exists for this event. Absent means no execution identity is applicable to this event.

correlation_id.description: Top-level correlation identifier for the overall action-to-execution chain this event belongs to. Always required, independent of which of action_id/intent_id/order_id/execution_id happen to exist for this specific event (HR-15).

payload.description: Open, event-type-specific structured detail. Absent means this event carries no detail beyond the envelope fields. Payload shape per event_type is owned by WI-G, not constrained by this envelope contract.
